contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ SEVERVS PIVS AVG ; R/ [F]ORT[VNA REDVX]

A silver roman denarius of Septimus Severus (r.193-211) reece period 10. Probably RIC IV Pt I 264a, FORTVNA REDVX reverse, minted between 201-210AD. Description: Obv.: Bearded laureatte bust right. Obv. legend: 'SEVERVS PIVS AVG'. Rev.: Fortuna seated left with rudder & cornucopiae. Rev. legend:'[F]ORT[VNA REDVX]'. Measurements: 18.79mm in diameter, 1.86mm thick and 1.98g in weight
